Name: BRAMBLE WHIP
Main Effect:
You summon forth a vine from the ground to whip **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[1d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity**.

Name: BARKSKIN
Main Effect:
You cover the skin of **an entity** you can touch with bark.

The target gains [[2d6 + 2*stat]] Shield and +1 Defense. The effect ends when all Shield is depleted.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, the target gains an additional [[1d6 + stat]] Shield.

Name: ENTANGLING ROOTS
Main Effect:
Roots burst from the ground, covering a **6-meter (20-foot)** area centered on a point you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Reflex of **all entities** in the area. On a success, they are rooted for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

Entities rooted by this spell can spend 6 Action Points to break out of the vines.

Name: SLEEPING SPORES
Main Effect:
You manifest a **6-meter (20-foot)** cloud of invisible, odorless spores centered on a point you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Grit of **all entities** in the area. Entities that are currently in combat or can see you gain advantage on the roll.

On a success, the entity falls asleep for **1 hour**. This effect ends early if the target takes damage or **an entity** uses an action to shake them awake.

Name: PARASITIC SPORE
Main Effect:
You launch a burrowing spore pod at **an entity** you can see within **12 meters (40 feet)**. Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, the spore embeds itself in the target.

At your Turn End, the spore deals [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage to the target, and you regain Health equal to half the damage dealt.
Secondary Effect: At your Turn Start, pay 2 Willpower to keep the spore in place. Miss the Upkeep and the spell ends.

Name: VERDANT FIELD
Main Effect:
You create a field of greenery in a **30-meter (100-foot)** radius around you for **1 hour**.

A Short Rest inside grants [[2d6 + 2*stat]] Shield and 1 Karma. Standing in the field elevates your Flora spells by 1.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 3 Action Points and 4 Willpower to make the field last **24 hours** (permanent in natural terrain). A Long Rest inside then also grants these benefits and costs 1 fewer Supplies.

Name: THORN RAMPART
Main Effect:
You conjure a dense wall of razor-sharp briars at a location you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)** for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

The wall can be up to **12 meters (40 feet)** long, **1.5 meters (5 feet)** thick and **3 meters (10 feet)** tall, blocking line of sight.

**Any entity** attempting to pass through the wall or having their Turn Start in it takes [[3d6 + 3*stat]] {damage} damage, and you make a {stat} Roll {roll} against that entity’s Grit.

On a success, the entity becomes rooted **until its next Turn End**.

Name: NATURALIZE
Main Effect:
You touch a common object, instantly breaking it down into decaying organic matter.

The object cannot exceed 200 kg (440 lbs) or a **2-meter (6-foot)** cube, and cannot be metallic.

If the object is worn or held by **an entity**, destroying it takes a successful {stat} Melee Attack {roll} against them.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 3 Action Points and 6 Willpower to target uncommon objects.

Name: DEVOURING BLOSSOM
Main Effect:
A carnivorous flower opens at a point you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)** for **10 turns (1 minute)**. It has Health equal to [[10*stat]] and Defense equal to [[2*stat]].

At your Turn End, it snaps at **an entity** within **3 meters (10 feet)**. Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Reflex. On a success, the entity is swallowed: grappled and taking [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage at each of its Turn Starts.

The flower holds **up to 2 entities**, and frees what it holds when destroyed.

Name: SEEDLING SPIRITS
Main Effect:
You call up a number of plant spirits equal to half your {stat}, each in a space you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**, for **10 turns (1 minute)**.

Each spirit follows an ally of your choice and moves with them. At that ally’s Turn Start, it restores [[1d6 + stat]] Health.

An ally can spend 1 Action Point to crush their spirit and shed poisoned, diseased or bleeding out. The spirit is then gone, and cannot be targeted otherwise.

Name: IMPALING GROVE
Main Effect: Hardwood spears erupt in a **12-meter (40-foot)** area centered on a point you can see within **18 meters (60 feet)**. Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Reflex of **all entities** in the area. On a success, you deal [[4d6 + 4*stat]] damage and they are rooted and prone **until their next Turn End**.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 3 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, the area grows **3 meters (10 feet)**.

Name: BLIGHT POLLEN
Main Effect:
You exhale a **9-meter (30-foot)** cone of grey pollen.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Grit of **all entities** in the area. On a success, they cannot restore Health for **5 turns**.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may sacrifice Health equal to [[3*level]]. If you do, they are also diseased.

Name: WILD STRIDER
Main Effect: You embody the freedom of the wild **until your next Long Rest**. The Action Point cost of your {{Move}} action can no longer exceed 1 and your Movement Speed cannot be reduced. Your Jump Distance and Jump Height are doubled.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, target **an additional entity** you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)**.

Name: SNAKE!
Main Effect:
You manifest a snake spirit which hurls itself at **an entity** you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage, and the target is poisoned.

Name: SHARPEN SENSES
Main Effect:
You channel the spirit of the wild to heighten your perception for **1 hour**.

For the duration of the spell, you gain advantage on all skill checks that rely on one of your five senses.
Secondary Effect: While this spell is active, you may spend 2 Willpower to reroll a failed skill check that relies on one of your five senses. You can only use this effect once per skill check.

Name: PRIMAL ROAR
Main Effect:
You emulate the ferocity of the wild, letting out a bellowing roar that echoes across the battlefield.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Grit of **all hostile entities** that can hear you within **36 meters (120 feet)**.

On a success, the entity must spend 2 Action Points on its next turn to move away from you. If the target has any Reaction Points available, it immediately spends them to start moving away from you first.

Name: WILD SWEEP
Main Effect:
You manifest the spirit of a large flying creature to swoop at **an entity** you can see within **12 meters (40 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage and the target is carried **12 meters (40 feet)** where you choose.
Secondary Effect: When this spell hits, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, it is carried an additional **3 meters (10 feet)**.

Name: SAVAGE SLAM
Main Effect:
You manifest the spirit of a mighty beast to slam the ground in a **6-meter (20-foot)** cone in front of you.

Make a {stat} Attack Roll {roll} against **all entities** in the area. On a hit, you deal [[4d6 + 4*stat]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 2 Action Points and 2 Willpower to affect a **6-meter (20-foot)** radius centered on you instead of a cone.

Name: PACK BOND
Main Effect:
You form a predatory bond with **up to 5 allies** you can see for **10 turns (1 minute)**, binding you together as a Wild Pack. While this spell is active:

Attack Rolls against a member have disadvantage while it is adjacent to another member. Members gain advantage on Attack Rolls against **an entity** adjacent to at least 2 members.

If a member falls unconscious or dies, every remaining member’s next attack is a guaranteed Critical Hit. Friendly fire and self-harm cannot trigger this.

Name: BIRD VIEW
Main Effect:
You manifest a small spectral flying creature and project your consciousness into it for up to **1 hour**.

For the duration, you gain an aerial view of the surrounding area through the creature’s senses up to **500 meters (1,500 feet)** away from your physical body.

While controlling the creature, your physical body is incapacitated and cannot take actions.

You may end Bird View early.

Name: FORCE INEBRIATION
Main Effect:
You attempt to ferment the blood of **an entity** you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, the target becomes poisoned. Outside of combat, the target is unaware of the spell’s source and believes it fell suddenly ill.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity**.

Name: SENSE LIFE
Main Effect:
You open your awareness to the pulse of surrounding life.

For **10 turns (1 minute)**, you sense the exact location and health state of **all living entities** within **18 meters (60 feet)**, even through total cover or darkness.
Secondary Effect: While this spell is active, you may spend 3 Action Points and 3 Willpower to mark **an entity** within range. You keep sensing its location and health state **until your next Long Rest**, even past your range.

Name: RENEW
Main Effect: You mend the flesh of **an entity** you touch, restoring [[1d6 + stat]] Health immediately and again at the Turn Start of the target’s next **2 turns**.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 2 Action Points and 2 Willpower. If you do, you instantly restore [[2d6 + 2*stat]] Health to **all entities** currently affected by your Renew, regardless of range or line of sight.

Name: GIANT GROWTH
Main Effect: You infuse **an entity** you can touch with life energy, tripling its size, doubling its Movement Speed and granting it Empowered for **10 turns**.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend 3 Willpower for **each additional entity** you can touch.

Name: BLEEDING TRAIL
Main Effect:
You touch a blood sample to create a trail of red mist that only you can see.

The trail lasts for **12 hours** and, if followed, leads you directly to the entity the blood came from.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may sacrifice Health equal to your {physique} [[physique]]. If you do, you receive a clear mental image of the entity the blood originated from.

Name: BLOOD SPEAR
Main Effect:
You manifest a spear of blood and hurl it at **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll} against the target. On a hit, you deal [[3d6 + 3*stat]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may sacrifice Health equal to your {physique} [[physique]]. If you do, the attack is made with advantage and the damage is Empowered by 1.

Name: GORE ARMOR
Main Effect:
You expend some of your blood to create a protective layer.

You sacrifice Health equal to [[3*physique]] and gain Shield equal to [[6*physique]].
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may sacrifice a further Health equal to [[2*physique]]. If you do, you gain additional Shield equal to the Health sacrificed.

Name: VAMPIRIC TOUCH
Main Effect:
You attempt to drain the life force of **an entity** you can touch.

Make a {stat} Melee Attack {roll} against the target. On a hit, you deal [[3d6 + 3*stat]] {damage} damage and regain Health equal to half the damage dealt.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may sacrifice Health equal to your {physique} [[physique]]. If you do, the attack is made with advantage and the damage is Empowered by 1.

Name: ROTTING TOUCH
Main Effect:
You attempt to rot away **an entity** you can touch.

Make a {stat} Melee Attack {roll} against the target. On a hit, you deal [[4d6 + 4*stat]] {damage} damage.

Name: SICKNESS
Main Effect:
You attempt to infect **an entity** you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll} against the target. On a hit, the target is diseased.
Secondary Effect: While an entity is diseased by this spell, you may spend 4 Action Points and 4 Willpower. If you do, **all entities** within **6 meters (20 feet)** of it are also diseased.

Name: MIMIC DEATH
Main Effect:
You disguise yourself and **up to 5 entities** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)** as corpses for **1 hour**, at a freshness you choose.

A disguised entity stays conscious, and taking any action breaks the spell.

A physical inspection treats it as a corpse unless the examiner succeeds on a {mind} Roll against your Grit.

Name: DREDGE CORPSE
Main Effect: A corpse rises from the earth at a point on the ground you can see.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 2 Action Points and 2 Willpower. If you do, the corpse rises bloated. Any ability that uses it is Empowered and Elevated.

Name: PESTILENT CLOUD
Main Effect:
You raise a Pestilent Cloud in a **6-meter (20-foot)** area centered on a point you can see within **12 meters (40 feet)** that lasts for **5 turns**.

An entity that enters the cloud, or is inside it at its Turn Start, takes [[2d6 + 2*stat]] {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: While this spell is active, you may spend 2 Action Points and 2 Willpower to move the cloud to another point you can see within range.

Name: CORPSE STRIDE
Main Effect: You teleport to a corpse you can see within **18 meters (60 feet)**.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 2 Action Points and 2 Willpower. If you do, the corpse explodes, dealing [[2d6 + 2*stat]] damage to **all entities** within **3 meters (10 feet)** of it.

Name: CORRUPT LIFE
Main Effect:
You curse **an entity** you can see within **6 meters (20 feet)** for **2 turns**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, Health the target would restore is converted into {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect: When casting this spell, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 3 Willpower any number of times. For each time you do, target **an additional eligible entity**.

Name: GORE BLAST
Main Effect:
A corpse you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)** explodes.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Reflex of **all entities** within **6 meters (20 feet)** of it. On a success, you deal [[1d6 + stat]] {damage} damage and afflict them with Corpse Carrion for **5 turns**.

Name: UNALIVE
Main Effect:
You unleash a beam of crackling magic at **an entity** you can see within **9 meters (30 feet)**.

You deal [[8d6 + 8*stat]] {damage} damage. If it does not reduce the target to 0 Health it is negated, and if it does the target dies instantly.

This damage cannot be modified in any way.

Name: ENBRITTLE
Main Effect:
You attempt to weaken the constitution of **an entity** you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)**.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, the next time the target takes damage it is vulnerable to that damage type.

Name: DEATH WAIL
Main Effect:
You ward yourself with necrotic magic **until your next Long Rest**.

The next time you would be brought down, you return to 1 Health instead and gain Shield equal to your maximum Health.

You cannot restore Health until you take a Long Rest, and any Health damage you take kills you instantly.

Name: GORE SPIKE
Main Effect:
A corpse you can see within **15 meters (50 feet)** erupts into a spike of gore.

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll} against **an entity** within **6 meters (20 feet)** of it. On a hit, you deal [[6d6 + 6*stat]] {damage} damage.
